objective: Test whether fixed equal-norm block concatenation preserves complementary raw-SAVE, kernel-mean, and local observed/residual geometry in one continuous OI distance space.

ancestry.adaptation: motivated by frozen RFF-mean evidence that raw SAVE and kernel conditional means carry complementary family-specific signal; exploratory development only

block_geometry.save: exact raw-observed-space pooled-residual SAVE rank-8 transform
block_geometry.rff_mean: exact 64-dimensional median-bandwidth RFF plus regularized target-cell mean rank-8 transform
block_geometry.residual: exact raw-observed-space pooled residual rank-8 correction retaining the full feature dimension
block_geometry.normalization: each transformed row in each block is independently L2-normalized, multiplied by 1/sqrt(number_of_blocks), and concatenated in the declared order
block_geometry.metric: ordinary Euclidean distance in the concatenated space; one FusedKMeans fit and one continuous OI score
block_geometry.weights: fixed equal block norms; no learned, family-dependent, or outcome-tuned block weights
block_geometry.leakage: all SAVE, residual, RFF bandwidth/map, target cells, kernel means, whitening, and projections are fitted inside each cross-fit training fold

reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen heads on observed features

reference_performance_gate.interpretation: Aggregate claims require every per-panel performance floor and both nonlinear-head win counts to pass.

success_gate.overall_requirement: A method passes only if overall Spearman is at least SAVE, mean regret is no more than 0.02 worse, every listed first/second-moment family loses at most 0.10 Spearman, sinusoid gains at least 0.20, and triangle wave gains at least 0.15. Any frozen block set may pass; no weights or blocks are selected from outcomes.

axis_metrics.quality_at_fixed_nuisance: Primary monotonic ranking estimand within each nuisance level.
axis_metrics.nuisance_at_fixed_quality: Secondary sensitivity estimand within each quality level.

primary_contrasts: SAVE plus RFF-mean versus each independent input block
adding observed geometry versus the two-block metric
adding residual-corrected local geometry versus the two-block metric
all multi-view variants versus residual-only and the privileged quadratic-lift ceiling
primary_metrics: panel and fixed-nuisance quality Spearman with the best-head envelope
negative actual-loss and negative loss-ratio Spearman
tie_rule: Average envelope performance across candidates tied at absolute tolerance 1e-12 for the maximum selector score.
scope: Exploratory synthetic development evidence on previously observed panel families; no production, confirmation, or generalization claim.
